propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran the staging environment for the console as service coordinator, executing release rehearsals for eleven candidate releases and leading incident drills.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the drill log document the staging coordination and drills.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate maintained the service runbooks and the availability report template and updated the runbooks after each rehearsal.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the runbook and template maintenance.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran the console's live service and led production incident response for customer-facing outages.
propositions.rationale: The resume places the candidate in staging with synthetic accounts and outside the live on-call rota; the incidents he led were drills, as he confirmed in the screen.

expectedGap: The materials document staging rehearsals and drills; they do not document the candidate operating the live service, holding production on-call or handling customer-facing incidents.
expectedBoundaryNote: Preserve the environment the resume names: staging drills with synthetic accounts; production incidents were the live service team's, whose on-call rota the candidate was not on.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate has ever been on a production on-call rota or led a customer-facing incident, and when.
